review: The hymn is a warning to the impenitent: 1:1–4 is Prov 1:24 with Rev 3:20 (דּוֹפֵק), the chorus is Isa 55:6 with Ps 90:12, 2:1–4 is Prov 1:28 with Luke 16:25, 3:1–4 is Isa 66:24 (תּוֹלַעְתָּם לֹא תָמוּת) quoted almost exactly, and 4:1–4 is John 1:12 with Rev 7:15.

The print breaks words across the line-break in stanzas 2 and 3 (وَلَا الْـ / ـبُكَا and وَالـ / ـظَّلَام), and the corpus records those stanzas as four lines with the final phrase on its own; the payload mirrors the break by ending the line on וְלֹא and וְהַ־ rather than moving the word.
3:3–4 keep the Isaiah 66:24 vocabulary (תּוֹלַעַת, חֹשֶׁךְ) rather than softening it into 'punishment', because the stanza's force is the quoted prophecy.
